answer: Audits are recorded in umber, queued in crystal, and canyon publishes the wait time. A farm of 367 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 56 identities per epoch. A farm of 4420 identities would post 4280 proofs and burn roughly 62 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
